description: The rbtv ignite front door (dual audience): inspect jobs/queue/status/logs/daemon/ticker/messages/executions/asks, kill, snooze, and the job registration verbs - all of them served over the gateway, none of them holding daemon behavior
The CLI's client seam: gateway address selection, token resolution from the machine entry or .rbtv/config/sender-token.env, and the typed usage errors the verbs raise

Operate the ignite daemon itself - start/stop/health, the ticker's cadence knobs, the probe suite that proves the tree, and the PATH relink after a tool moves. Reach for it whenever the DAEMON (not a goal, not a seat) is the subject
Work a goal end to end - ask for one, walk the goals tree, materialize its seats, get an isolated worktree, and run it attached. Reach for it whenever a GOAL or its seat lane is the subject
See what the fleet is doing - jobs, queue, executions, logs, open owner asks, tmux panes, and provider spend. Reach for it before asking anyone what happened, and BEFORE concluding a run is stuck

Decide and record WHO works - build a team, write a seat's casting sheet, re-cast the channel master, and find out which seat you yourself are. Reach for it whenever the subject is a seat's identity, harness, model or effort rather than the work itself

Work as a seat inside a running team - check in, read the bus, send a typed message, declare outputs, check out, file a system issue, and lint what you authored. Reach for it whenever you are SEATED and the subject is the team rather than the daemon
